text:
I got early access to SpaceXAI’s new Grok @Bot template sharing feature, which lets you create custom Bot templates that other people can download and use.

I created Clipper. It turns videos from X or your own files into short clips and GIFs with a clear angle. It watches the footage, picks the joke, captions talking GIFs, files them into local buckets, and can publish GIFs to Giphy.

Here’s the direct link to download the template: https://x.ai/bot/ozEfaAFJMDGoB-ysym8_V
